The second is the SheafedSpace `fst_of_right` instance, which copies the whole `snd_of_left` argument where the file already uses a symmetry shortcut for the same fact in other categories. findings.declaration: PresheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.invApp / inv_invApp / invApp_app (and the SheafedSpace and LocallyRingedSpace restatements)
findings.problem: The fact `(Opens.map f.base).obj ((opensFunctor f).obj U) = U` is reproved inline at least eight times. These are lines 124, 177, 199, 207, 253, 821, 827, and the longer `have := Set.preimage_image_eq U.1 ...; dsimp at this; simp [...]` blocks at 1235 and 1245. Each is the same set-level argument that preimage of image equals the set for an injective map. The proofs sit inside `eqToHom` arguments in statements and definitions, so the same `by simp [Opens.map_def, ...]` text is copied into each lemma statement. The LocallyRingedSpace copies use a different, longer proof of the same fact. Mathlib already has `TopologicalSpace.Opens.map_functor_eq'` for exactly this equality.
findings.proposed_change: Use the existing lemma `TopologicalSpace.Opens.map_functor_eq' f.base H.base_open U : (Opens.map f.base).obj (H.base_open.functor.obj U) = U` (it takes `f : U ⟶ X` and `hf : IsOpenEmbedding f`). Replace each inline proof with `eqToHom (Opens.map_functor_eq' _ H.base_open U)`, and in `isoRestrict`/`ofRestrict` with `Opens.ext`/`Opens.map_functor_eq' _ hf _`. If the repeated term is still too bulky, add one local lemma such as `map_opensFunctor_obj (U : Opens X) : (Opens.map f.base).obj ((opensFunctor f).obj U) = U := Opens.map_functor_eq' _ H.base_open U`. Then `invApp`, `inv_invApp`, `invApp_app` and their SheafedSpace and LocallyRingedSpace copies all write `eqToHom (map_opensFunctor_obj f U)`. The two LocallyRingedSpace blocks at 1235 and 1245 then become identical to the others.
findings.benefit: This removes about eight copies of the set-level argument and the `simp` call that must match its exact form. The `eqToHom` in each statement becomes visibly the same morphism across the three layers (Presheafed, Sheafed, LocallyRinged). A change in how `Opens.map`/`functor` unfold would need one fix instead of many.

findings.problem: `sheafedSpace_pullback_fst_of_right` repeats the whole proof of `sheafedSpace_pullback_snd_of_left` (lines 713–723). Both rewrite along `preservesLimitIso_hom_π`, then along `HasLimit.isoOfNatIso_hom_π` with `diagramIsoCospan`, then `dsimp`, `Category.comp_id`, `rw ← this`, and `infer_instance`. The only change is swapping `right` for `left` and `f g` for `g f`. Both also carry the same two `set_option`s. The same file proves the corresponding right-hand statements for PresheafedSpace (`pullbackFstOfRight`) and LocallyRingedSpace (`pullback_fst_of_right`) by a two-line symmetry argument, without repeating the limit-comparison argument.
findings.proposed_change: Replace the body with the pattern used elsewhere in the file: `instance sheafedSpace_pullback_fst_of_right : SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst g f) := by rw [← pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]; infer_instance`. This should work because `pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd` rewrites `pullback.fst g f` to `(pullbackSymmetry g f).hom ≫ pullback.snd f g`. The instances `sheafedSpace_pullback_snd_of_left` (needs `H`), `SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_isIso` (for the symmetry iso), and `comp` supply the rest. The two `set_option`s on this instance can then be dropped.
findings.benefit: This removes a roughly 10-line duplicate of the only nontrivial limit-comparison argument and makes the three layers (Presheafed, Sheafed, LocallyRinged) prove `fst_of_right` the same way. Future changes to the transparency and defeq options need to be made in one proof only.
